Name: Better Crops and Foraging
Author: cometkins
Description:
[center][b][size=5]THIS MOD IS ONLY AVAILABLE ON NEXUSMODS, DO NOT UPLOAD ANYWHERE ELSE.[/size]

[/b]Want to change up the look of your crops and foraging in the game? Then you've come to the right place!

Better Crops and Foraging's goal is to change the look of all harvestable crops and foraging items to be more realistic, and thus a little more toned down in color. It should be a little more pleasant on the eyes overall, and goes great with any other toned down map recolors you might be using. All you need is SMAPI and Content Patcher to make things work!

This mod affects the harvested items as well as any relevant growing crops, so all crops that have had their art changed have crops to match.

[b][size=3]Download Instructions:[/size]
[/b]1.) Make sure you have both SMAPI and Content Patcher downloaded and ready.
2.) Download this mod from Nexus.
3.) Drag and drop the unzipped file to your mod folder, and presto!
4.) Load up Stardew and enjoy!
[u]5.) Config file will be created upon first loading the mod. Switch any crops/forageables to 'false' if you would like to avoid using them.[/u]
